import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


print("Loading data...")
train_full = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=500000)
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Parse datetime properly
train_full["pickup_datetime"] = train_full["pickup_datetime"].str.replace(" UTC", "")
train_full["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train_full["pickup_datetime"])

# Clean training data aggressively
train_full = train_full.dropna()
train_full = train_full[
    (train_full["fare_amount"] > 0) & (train_full["fare_amount"] < 200)
]
train_full = train_full[
    (train_full["pickup_latitude"].between(40, 42))
    & (train_full["pickup_longitude"].between(-75, -73))
]
train_full = train_full[
    (train_full["dropoff_latitude"].between(40, 42))
    & (train_full["dropoff_longitude"].between(-75, -73))
]
train_full = train_full[
    (train_full["passenger_count"] > 0) & (train_full["passenger_count"] <= 6)
]

# Sort by datetime for time-based split
train_full = train_full.sort_values("pickup_datetime").reset_index(drop=True)


# Feature engineering
def create_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    if df["pickup_datetime"].dtype == "object":
        df["pickup_datetime"] = df["pickup_datetime"].str.replace(" UTC", "")
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["pickup_hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["pickup_dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["pickup_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["distance_km"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["manhattan_km"] = (df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]).abs() + (
        df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"]
    ).abs()
    return df


train_full = create_features(train_full)

# Time-based split: use last 15% as validation
split_idx = int(len(train_full) * 0.85)
train_data_full = train_full.iloc[:split_idx]
val_data = train_full.iloc[split_idx:].reset_index(drop=True)

feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_dayofweek",
    "pickup_month",
    "distance_km",
    "manhattan_km",
]

X_train = train_data_full[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_data_full["fare_amount"].values
X_val = val_data[feature_cols].values
y_val = val_data["fare_amount"].values

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_cols)
val_data_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, feature_name=feature_cols, reference=train_data
)

params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

print("Training LightGBM model with time-based validation...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=100,
    valid_sets=[val_data_lgb],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Train final model on full training data (train + val) without validation to avoid dataset reference error
print("Training final model on full training data...")
X_full = train_full[feature_cols].values
y_full = train_full["fare_amount"].values
final_train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_full, label=y_full, feature_name=feature_cols)

# Train final model without validation set to avoid dataset reference issue
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    final_train_data,
    num_boost_round=100,
)

X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test["key"], "fare_amount": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
